svg.title: Figure A4. Shared and local signs

g.text: Figure A4. SYNTHETIC two-block shared-sign / local-corner calculation
Within each block: shared start shifts and shared end shifts are swept separately over record-edge breakpoints.
Shift candidates → scalar allowance; timing coordinates are lost.
Shift candidates → scalar allowance; timing coordinates are lost.
One shared sign s; independent signs e1,e2 → δ′j = δj + s qj + ej ℓj → eight rows in Table 4.
Recompute mean, SD and largest magnitude → Ucmp,shared = 8.8304376431 J.
A shared energy sign does not replay one physical time shift across blocks; no common-time conservatism is proven.
